heading_1.llm_guidance: A heading inside the calculator panel. Name what this part of the tool does in plain words. No negation, no aphorism, sentence case.

para_1.llm_guidance: Advisory copy inside the calculator panel. Plain UK English, framed as something the reader can act on. Keep every figure and factual claim unless the brief for the edit says otherwise.

label_1.llm_guidance: LOAD-BEARING COPY: this is the visible label a reader uses to decide what number to type, and the arithmetic oracle asserts against it. Changing what it MEANS (not just its wording) silently changes what users believe the calculator computes. Reword for voice only; never change the quantity it names, its unit, or its currency marker.
